name: ghoul
description: This port lives inside the Ghoul repository and builds the enclosing checkout. When publishing Ghoul to a registry, replace the path-based source in the portfile with vcpkg_from_github(REPO OpenSpace/Ghoul REF <tag> SHA512 <hash>).

The dependency list is kept in sync with the manifest at the root of the Ghoul repository by support/vcpkg/check-manifest-sync.cmake, except that this port does not build the unit tests and therefore omits Catch2, and it depends on the vcpkg-cmake host tools explicitly.
Ghoul's overrides (lua 5.4.7) cannot be expressed by a port, so a superproject that consumes this port has to repeat them in its own manifest.
